headline: Software standardizes LC-MS/MS and imaging mass spectrometry data processing and QC
label: Mass Spectrometry Analysis Tools
summary: Recent tools link vendor-agnostic QC, curated metabolite knowledge, and imaging MS data into shared multi-modal analysis workflows.
synthesis: The dominant thread is software that makes mass spectrometry-derived data reproducible and interoperable across instrument monitoring, metabolite annotation, and multi-modal analysis. MaSpeQC is a free, vendor-agnostic interactive web app that tracks LC-MS/MS performance across proteomic, metabolomic, and lipidomic QC samples. CMMC-KB is a community-curated knowledgebase of microbial metabolites that links LC-MS/MS untargeted metabolomics data to downstream tools. Thyra is a Python library that converts mass spectrometry imaging data into the SpatialData format, integrating MSI into spatial omics workflows. The distinguishing feature across these items is the coupling of shared curated resources and vendor-agnostic QC with interoperable data models, rather than single-method algorithms. VenomsBase, a FAIR-aligned modular cloud platform for venomous species, shares the infrastructure emphasis but is not mass spectrometry-specific in the summary provided.
